task_prompt: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Implement VQE in Cirq (with sympy parameters and scipy) for the 2-qubit Hamiltonian H = 1.28*Z0*Z1 + 0.52*X0 + 0.52*X1. Compare the optimized energy with exact diagonalization. Give one complete script that runs end-to-end on its own and prints the outcome.
